extracted.name: Dianne's Fish Seasoning
extracted.description: The right seasoning for fish can really make a difference. This easy mix of dried herbs is great to have on hand the next time fish is on the menu!
instruction_lines: Combine basil, rosemary, parsley, sea salt, black pepper, sage, thyme, marjoram, oregano, celery salt, and garlic powder in a mixing bowl until evenly blended.
